eyebrow: Max pooling -- keep the strongest value
code:
import torch.nn as nn

pool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
# 2x2 window, non-overlapping --
# halves height and width,
# keeps only each window's max
caption: Discarding exact position gives a little tolerance to small shifts.

eyebrow: Average pooling -- smooth the window instead
code:
avg_pool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)

# same window, averages instead of
# taking the max -- smoother, less
# common as a default in CNN bodies
caption: Max pooling is the more common default inside a CNN's body.

eyebrow: Adaptive pooling -- target a fixed output size
code:
gap = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(output_size=(1, 1))

# global average pooling: one value
# per channel, regardless of the
# incoming spatial size
caption: Common right before a classifier -- decouples it from input size.
